d30: We're Dreams of X. For NASA's Abandoned but not Forgotten challenge, we built the Moon-Material Simulator. The machines left on the Moon show what it does to materials. Our free browser app predicts how NASA Glenn's bioplastic mixed with Moon dust will perform, from real, audited lab data. Rebuild a broken part, test it in 3D, and see the evidence behind every number. Next stop: Mars.
